# Descriptive Characteristics of Patients

```{r}
db_path <- fs::path("data.duckdb")

if (!fs::file_exists(path = db_path)) {
  rlang::abort(
    message = stringr::str_c(
      "The data.duckdb file was not found in the project root.",
      sep = " "
    )
  )
}

connection <- DBI::dbConnect(
  drv = duckdb::duckdb(),
  dbdir = db_path,
  read_only = TRUE
)

query_result <- tryCatch(
  expr = list(
    icu_admissions = DBI::dbGetQuery(
      conn = connection,
      statement = stringr::str_c(
        "SELECT age_years, sex, apache_ii_score,",
        "mechanical_ventilation_days, icu_stay_days,",
        "icu_outcome, hospital_outcome",
        "FROM icu_admissions",
        "ORDER BY patient_id",
        sep = " "
      )
    ),
    patient_clinical_status = DBI::dbGetQuery(
      conn = connection,
      statement = stringr::str_c(
        "SELECT rass_score, vas_score, cam_icu_result,",
        "borg_score, borg_rpe_score,",
        "hand_grip_strength_right, hand_grip_strength_left,",
        "mrc_score, icu_mobility_score",
        "FROM patient_clinical_status",
        "ORDER BY patient_id",
        sep = " "
      )
    ),
    physiological_assessments = DBI::dbGetQuery(
      conn = connection,
      statement = stringr::str_c(
        "SELECT patient_id, assessment, phase, pressure_support,",
        "positive_end_expiratory_pressure, tidal_volume,",
        "total_minute_ventilation, fraction_inspired_oxygen,",
        "respiratory_rate, t_piece, oxygen_saturation,",
        "blood_pressure_diastolic, blood_pressure_systolic,",
        "heart_rate, noradrenaline_rate, arterial_ph,",
        "arterial_oxygen_pressure,",
        "arterial_carbon_dioxide_pressure,",
        "ventilator_sensitivity, expiratory_sensitivity, rising_time",
        "FROM physiological_assessments",
        "WHERE assessment IN (
          'with_physiotherapy', 'without_physiotherapy'
        )",
        "AND phase IN (
          'before_physiotherapy', 'after_physiotherapy',
          'recording_start', 'recording_end'
        )",
        "ORDER BY patient_id, phase",
        sep = " "
      )
    ),
    sleep_assessments = DBI::dbGetQuery(
      conn = connection,
      statement = stringr::str_c(
        "SELECT patient_id, assessment, time_in_bed, total_sleep_time,",
        "sleep_efficiency, wake_after_sleep_onset, sleep_latency,",
        "stage_shifts, stage1_duration, stage1_percent_tst,",
        "stage2_duration, stage2_percent_tst,",
        "slow_wave_sleep_duration, slow_wave_sleep_percent_tst,",
        "rem_sleep_duration, rem_sleep_percent_tst, arousal_index,",
        "rcsq_score",
        "FROM sleep_assessments",
        "ORDER BY patient_id, assessment",
        sep = " "
      )
    )
  ),
  finally = DBI::dbDisconnect(
    conn = connection,
    shutdown = TRUE
  )
)

icu_admissions <- query_result$icu_admissions
patient_clinical_status <- query_result$patient_clinical_status
physiological_assessments <- query_result$physiological_assessments
sleep_assessments <- query_result$sleep_assessments
```

```{r}
parse_numeric <- function(values) {
  normalized_values <- values |>
    stringr::str_squish() |>
    stringr::str_replace_all(
      pattern = ",",
      replacement = "."
    ) |>
    stringr::str_remove(
      pattern = "%$"
    ) |>
    dplyr::na_if(y = "")

  suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(x = normalized_values)
  )
}

format_number <- function(value, digits = 1L) {
  formatC(
    x = value,
    format = "f",
    digits = digits,
    decimal.mark = "."
  )
}

format_n_percent <- function(count, denominator, digits = 1L) {
  percentage <- format_number(
    value = 100 * count / denominator,
    digits = digits
  )

  stringr::str_c(
    count,
    " (",
    percentage,
    "%)"
  )
}

translate_categories <- function(values) {
  trimmed_values <- stringr::str_squish(string = values)
  normalized_values <- stringr::str_to_lower(string = trimmed_values)

  dplyr::case_when(
    normalized_values %in% c(
      "male",
      "m",
      "άνδρας",
      "ανδρας",
      "άρρεν",
      "αρρεν"
    ) ~ "Male",
    normalized_values %in% c(
      "female",
      "f",
      "γυναίκα",
      "γυναικα",
      "θήλυ",
      "θηλυ"
    ) ~ "Female",
    normalized_values %in% c(
      "alive",
      "survived",
      "survivor",
      "επιβίωση",
      "επιβιωση",
      "επιβίωσε",
      "επιβιωσε"
    ) ~ "Survived",
    normalized_values %in% c(
      "έξοδος",
      "εξοδος"
    ) ~ "Discharged",
    normalized_values %in% c(
      "dead",
      "deceased",
      "death",
      "θάνατος",
      "θανατος",
      "απεβίωσε",
      "απεβιωσε"
    ) ~ "Death",
    TRUE ~ trimmed_values
  )
}

summarise_continuous <- function(label, values) {
  numeric_values <- parse_numeric(values = values)
  available_values <- numeric_values[!is.na(numeric_values)]
  missing_count <- sum(x = is.na(numeric_values))

  if (length(x = available_values) == 0L) {
    summary_text <- "Not available"
  } else {
    quartiles <- stats::quantile(
      x = available_values,
      probs = c(0.25, 0.50, 0.75),
      na.rm = TRUE,
      names = FALSE
    )
    summary_text <- stringr::str_c(
      format_number(value = quartiles[[2L]]),
      " [",
      format_number(value = quartiles[[1L]]),
      ", ",
      format_number(value = quartiles[[3L]]),
      "]"
    )
  }

  missing_text <- if (missing_count > 0L) {
    stringr::str_c("; missing: ", missing_count)
  } else {
    ""
  }

  tibble::tibble(
    variable = label,
    summary = stringr::str_c(
      summary_text,
      missing_text
    )
  )
}

summarise_categorical <- function(label, values, denominator) {
  translated_values <- translate_categories(values = values)
  translated_values <- dplyr::if_else(
    condition = is.na(translated_values) | translated_values == "",
    true = "Not available",
    false = translated_values
  )

  counts <- tibble::tibble(category = translated_values) |>
    dplyr::count(
      category,
      name = "count",
      sort = FALSE
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      display = purrr::map_chr(
        .x = .data$count,
        .f = function(count) {
          format_n_percent(
            count = count,
            denominator = denominator
          )
        }
      )
    )

  counts |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      variable = dplyr::if_else(
        condition = dplyr::row_number() == 1L,
        true = label,
        false = ""
      ),
      summary = stringr::str_c(
        .data$category,
        ": ",
        .data$display,
        sep = ""
      )
    )
}

n_patients <- nrow(x = icu_admissions)

table_1 <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  summarise_continuous(
    label = "Age (years)",
    values = icu_admissions$age_years
  ),
  summarise_categorical(
    label = "Sex",
    values = icu_admissions$sex,
    denominator = n_patients
  ),
  summarise_continuous(
    label = "APACHE II score",
    values = icu_admissions$apache_ii_score
  ),
  summarise_continuous(
    label = "Mechanical ventilation days",
    values = icu_admissions$mechanical_ventilation_days
  ),
  summarise_continuous(
    label = "ICU stay days",
    values = icu_admissions$icu_stay_days
  ),
  summarise_categorical(
    label = "ICU outcome",
    values = icu_admissions$icu_outcome,
    denominator = n_patients
  ),
  summarise_categorical(
    label = "In-hospital outcome",

)
```

## Physiological assessments

```{r}
#| include: false

plot_device <- ragg::agg_png

measurement_labels <- tibble::tibble(
  measurement = c(
    "pressure_support",
    "positive_end_expiratory_pressure",
    "tidal_volume",
    "total_minute_ventilation",
    "fraction_inspired_oxygen",
    "respiratory_rate",
    "t_piece",
    "oxygen_saturation",
    "arterial_ph",
    "arterial_oxygen_pressure",
    "arterial_carbon_dioxide_pressure",
    "blood_pressure_diastolic",
    "blood_pressure_systolic",
    "heart_rate",
    "noradrenaline_rate",
    "ventilator_sensitivity",
    "expiratory_sensitivity",
    "rising_time"
  ),
  label = c(
    "Pressure support (cmH2O)",
    "PEEP (cmH2O)",
    "Tidal volume (mL)",
    "Total minute ventilation (L/min)",
    "Fraction of inspired oxygen (%)",
    "Respiratory rate (/min)",
    "T-piece",
    "Oxygen saturation (%)",
    "Arterial pH",
    "Arterial oxygen pressure (mmHg)",
    "Arterial carbon dioxide pressure (mmHg)",
    "Diastolic blood pressure (mmHg)",
    "Systolic blood pressure (mmHg)",
    "Heart rate (bpm)",
    "Noradrenaline rate (mL/h)",
    "Ventilator sensitivity",
    "Expiratory sensitivity",
    "Rising time"
  ),
  group = c(
    rep("Ventilator settings", times = 7L),
    rep("Oxygenation and gas exchange", times = 4L),
    rep("Hemodynamics", times = 4L),
    rep("Ventilator control and timing", times = 3L)
  )
)

physiological_measurements <- physiological_assessments |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -c("patient_id", "assessment", "phase"),
    names_to = "measurement",
    values_to = "value",
    values_transform = list(value = as.character)
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    y = measurement_labels,
    by = "measurement"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    value = parse_numeric(values = .data$value),
    value = dplyr::case_when(
      .data$measurement == "fraction_inspired_oxygen" &
        !is.na(.data$value) &
        .data$value <= 1 ~ .data$value * 100,
      .data$measurement == "oxygen_saturation" &
        !is.na(.data$value) &
        .data$value <= 1 ~ .data$value * 100,
      TRUE ~ .data$value
    ),
    timepoint = dplyr::case_when(
      .data$assessment == "with_physiotherapy" &
        .data$phase == "before_physiotherapy" ~ "With physio - before",
      .data$assessment == "with_physiotherapy" &
        .data$phase == "after_physiotherapy" ~ "With physio - after",
      .data$assessment == "without_physiotherapy" &
        .data$phase == "recording_start" ~ "Without physio - start",
      .data$assessment == "without_physiotherapy" &
        .data$phase == "recording_end" ~ "Without physio - end",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    assessment = dplyr::recode(
      .data$assessment,
      with_physiotherapy = "With physiotherapy",
      without_physiotherapy = "Without physiotherapy"
    ),
    timepoint = factor(
      x = .data$timepoint,
      levels = c(
        "With physio - before",
        "With physio - after",
        "Without physio - start",
        "Without physio - end"
      )
    ),
    measurement = factor(
      x = .data$label,
      levels = measurement_labels$label
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(.data$value),
    !is.na(.data$label),
    !is.na(.data$timepoint)
  )

build_physiotherapy_pair_measurements <- function(
    physiological_measurements) {
  physiological_measurements |>
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$assessment == "With physiotherapy",
      .data$phase %in% c(
        "before_physiotherapy",
        "after_physiotherapy"
      ),
      .data$measurement %in% c(
        "Heart rate (bpm)",
        "Respiratory rate (/min)"
      )
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      comparison = dplyr::recode(
        .data$phase,
        before_physiotherapy = "Before physiotherapy",
        after_physiotherapy = "After physiotherapy"
      ),
      comparison = factor(
        x = .data$comparison,
        levels = c("Before physiotherapy", "After physiotherapy")
      )
    ) |>
    dplyr::group_by(.data$patient_id, .data$measurement) |>
    dplyr::filter(dplyr::n() == 2L) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()
}

make_physiological_boxplot <- function(
    data,
    title,
    y_limits = NULL) {
  if (nrow(x = data) == 0L) {
    return(
      ggplot2::ggplot() +
        ggplot2::annotate(
          geom = "text",
          x = 1,
          y = 1,
          label = "No numeric observations available"
        ) +
        ggplot2::labs(
          title = title,
          subtitle = "This measurement group was not available."
        ) +
        ggplot2::theme_void()
    )
  }

  if (is.null(y_limits)) {
    plot_data <- data
    scale_data <- NULL
  } else {
    limit_table <- tibble::tibble(
      measurement = names(y_limits),
      lower = purrr::map_dbl(
        .x = y_limits,
        .f = 1L
      ),
      upper = purrr::map_dbl(
        .x = y_limits,
        .f = 2L
      )
    ) |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        measurement = factor(
          x = .data$measurement,
          levels = levels(data$measurement)
        )
      )

    plot_data <- data |>
      dplyr::left_join(
        y = limit_table,
        by = "measurement"
      ) |>
      dplyr::filter(
        is.na(.data$lower) |
          dplyr::between(
            x = .data$value,
            left = .data$lower,
            right = .data$upper
          )
      )

    scale_data <- limit_table |>
      tidyr::pivot_longer(
        cols = c("lower", "upper"),
        names_to = "limit",
        values_to = "value"
      ) |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        timepoint = data$timepoint[[1L]]
      )
  }

  plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    data = plot_data,
    mapping = ggplot2::aes(
      x = .data$timepoint,
      y = .data$value,
      fill = .data$assessment
    )
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_boxplot(
      position = ggplot2::position_dodge2(
        width = 0.8,
        preserve = "single"
      ),
      width = 0.7,
      outlier.alpha = 0.35,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "With physiotherapy" = "#4472C4",
        "Without physiotherapy" = "#70AD47"
      ),
      name = "Assessment"
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = "With and without physiotherapy across study timepoints",
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL
    ) +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(
      facets = ggplot2::vars(measurement),
      scales = "free_y",
      ncol = 2
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(
        angle = 45,
        hjust = 1,
        vjust = 1
      ),
      strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "top"
    )

  if (!is.null(scale_data)) {
    plot <- plot +
      ggplot2::geom_blank(
        data = scale_data,
        mapping = ggplot2::aes(
          x = .data$timepoint,
          y = .data$value
        ),
        inherit.aes = FALSE
      ) +
      ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
        expand = c(0, 0)
      )
  }

  plot
}

sleep_measurements <- sleep_assessments |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -c("patient_id", "assessment"),
    names_to = "measurement",
    values_to = "value",
    values_transform = list(value = as.character)
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    y = sleep_measurement_labels,
    by = "measurement"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(

      .data$assessment,
      with_physiotherapy = "With physiotherapy",
      without_physiotherapy = "Without physiotherapy"
    ),
    assessment = factor(

      levels = c("With physiotherapy", "Without physiotherapy")
    ),
    measurement = factor(
      x = .data$label,
      levels = sleep_measurement_labels$label
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(.data$value),
    !is.na(.data$label),
    !is.na(.data$assessment)
  )

build_sleep_pair_measurements <- function(sleep_assessments) {
  sleep_assessments |>
    dplyr::select(
      "patient_id",
      "assessment",
      "total_sleep_time",
      "sleep_latency"
    ) |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = c("total_sleep_time", "sleep_latency"),
      names_to = "measurement",
      values_to = "value",
      values_transform = list(value = as.character)
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      value = parse_numeric(values = .data$value),
      comparison = dplyr::recode(
        .data$assessment,
        with_physiotherapy = "With physiotherapy",
        without_physiotherapy = "Without physiotherapy"
      ),
      comparison = factor(
        x = .data$comparison,
        levels = c("Without physiotherapy", "With physiotherapy")
      )
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data$value)) |>
    dplyr::group_by(.data$patient_id, .data$measurement) |>
    dplyr::filter(dplyr::n() == 2L) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()
}

make_paired_measurement_plot <- function(
    data,
    title,
    y_label,
    subtitle,
    x_levels,
    comparison_colors,
    legend_title,
    facet = FALSE) {
  if (nrow(x = data) == 0L) {
    return(
      ggplot2::ggplot() +
        ggplot2::annotate(
          geom = "text",
          x = 1,
          y = 1,
          label = "No complete patient pairs available"
        ) +
        ggplot2::labs(
          title = title,
          subtitle = subtitle,
          x = NULL,
          y = y_label
        ) +
        ggplot2::theme_void()
    )
  }

  plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    data = data,
    mapping = ggplot2::aes(
      x = .data$comparison,
      y = .data$value,
      group = .data$patient_id
    )
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_line(
      color = "#A6A6A6",
      alpha = 0.65,
      linewidth = 0.6
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      mapping = ggplot2::aes(color = .data$comparison),
      shape = 16,
      size = 2.4
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(
      values = comparison_colors,
      name = legend_title
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(
      limits = x_levels
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = subtitle,
      x = NULL,
      y = y_label
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      legend.position = "top"
    )

  if (facet) {
    plot <- plot +
      ggplot2::facet_wrap(
        facets = ggplot2::vars(measurement),
        scales = "free_y",
        ncol = 2
      ) +
      ggplot2::theme(
        strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold")
      )
  }

  plot
}

sleep_pair_measurements <- build_sleep_pair_measurements(
  sleep_assessments = sleep_assessments

  )

make_sleep_boxplot <- function(data, title) {
  if (nrow(x = data) == 0L) {
    return(
      ggplot2::ggplot() +
        ggplot2::annotate(
          geom = "text",
          x = 1,
          y = 1,
          label = "No numeric observations available"
        ) +
        ggplot2::labs(
          title = title,
          subtitle = "This measurement group was not available."
        ) +
        ggplot2::theme_void()
    )
  }

  ggplot2::ggplot(
    data = data,
    mapping = ggplot2::aes(
      x = .data$assessment,
      y = .data$value,
      fill = .data$assessment
    )
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_boxplot(
      width = 0.7,
      outlier.alpha = 0.35,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "With physiotherapy" = "#4472C4",
        "Without physiotherapy" = "#70AD47"
      ),
      name = "Assessment"
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = "With and without physiotherapy",
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL
    ) +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(
      facets = ggplot2::vars(measurement),
      scales = "free_y",
      ncol = 2
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(
        angle = 45,
        hjust = 1,
        vjust = 1
      ),
      strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "top"
    )
}
```

{{< pagebreak >}}

## Sleep assessment comparisons

Within-patient differences between assessments with and without
physiotherapy were evaluated using two-sided paired Wilcoxon signed-rank
tests for total sleep time, sleep latency, time in bed, sleep efficiency,
arousal index, RCSQ score, and wake after sleep onset. Only complete pairs
were analyzed, without imputation. To account for multiple comparisons across
the seven prespecified sleep outcomes, p-values were adjusted using Holm's
step-down procedure. Both unadjusted and adjusted p-values are reported.

```{r}
sleep_test_labels <- c(
  total_sleep_time = "Total sleep time (min)",
  sleep_latency = "Sleep latency (min)",
  time_in_bed = "Time in bed (min)",
  sleep_efficiency = "Sleep efficiency (%)",
  arousal_index = "Arousal index (/h)",
  rcsq_score = "RCSQ score",
  wake_after_sleep_onset = "WASO (min)"
)

sleep_test_data <- sleep_assessments |>
  dplyr::select(
    "patient_id",
    "assessment",
    dplyr::all_of(names(sleep_test_labels))
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(
      .cols = dplyr::all_of(names(sleep_test_labels)),
      .fns = parse_numeric
    )
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols = "patient_id",
    names_from = "assessment",
    values_from = dplyr::all_of(names(sleep_test_labels)),
    names_glue = "{.value}_{assessment}"
  )

sleep_test_results <- purrr::map_dfr(
  .x = names(sleep_test_labels),
  .f = function(measurement) {
    with_column <- stringr::str_c(
      measurement,
      "_with_physiotherapy"
    )
    without_column <- stringr::str_c(
      measurement,
      "_without_physiotherapy"
    )
    complete_pairs <- sleep_test_data |>
      dplyr::filter(
        !is.na(.data[[with_column]]),
        !is.na(.data[[without_column]])
      )

    if (nrow(x = complete_pairs) == 0L) {
      p_value <- NA_real_
    } else {
      test_result <- stats::wilcox.test(
        x = complete_pairs[[with_column]],
        y = complete_pairs[[without_column]],
        paired = TRUE
      )
      p_value <- test_result$p.value
    }

    tibble::tibble(
      variable = unname(sleep_test_labels[[measurement]]),
      complete_pairs = nrow(x = complete_pairs),
      p_value = p_value
    )
  }
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    holm_adjusted_p_value = stats::p.adjust(
      p = .data$p_value,
      method = "holm"
    )
  )

sleep_test_results_display <- sleep_test_results |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    p_value = format_number(
      value = .data$p_value,
      digits = 3L
    ),
    holm_adjusted_p_value = format_number(
      value = .data$holm_adjusted_p_value,
      digits = 3L
    )
  )
```

```{r}
knitr::kable(
  x = sleep_test_results_display,
  format = "pipe",
  col.names = c(
    "Sleep measure",
    "Complete pairs",
    "Wilcoxon p-value",
    "Holm-adjusted p-value"
  ),
  caption = paste(
    "Paired Wilcoxon signed-rank tests for seven sleep outcomes",
    "comparing assessments with and without physiotherapy."
  )
)
```
